policy: Only locally downloaded, source-credited photos with exact product-name metadata, a commercial-use license, >=700px resolution, no detected faces/people and no near-duplicate check are treated as verified. Other products use a labeled product-only SVG.
notes: Four user-provided product photos were reviewed by product ID and added: 110 Serum, 146 Makeup Organizer, 298 Personal Medicines, 338 Hijab. Their third-party licensing status has not been independently verified.
Body Spray ID 193 was visually checked against its product name and added from the user-provided ZIP; third-party license is not independently verified.

Face-photo review: scanned all 252 active catalog photos with OpenCV YuNet at confidence threshold 0.65; 31 possible-face images were removed and replaced with a no-person illustration. Automated detection can have false positives and may miss tiny/distant faces.
